notes.title: Development Update - YOUR team the way YOU like
notes.notes:
Team Customization

In Olé, we want players to feel that their team is unique. So you will have almost unlimited combinations of colors, emblems, card backs and uniforms.

We are still in a very early stage of development, but we bring a taste of how everything will look.

Uniforms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38066668/807d1445023dca78d3623ee4b6e2da6135a56f73.jpg

Colors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38066668/9456d87cd0cf2a4e9f89aa7f4640cd18c504538c.jpg

When you change colors and uniforms, even your cards follow the style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38066668/61c6b7e5e6b55749a09b6a5dc4bf59830f898963.gif

No to mention your players...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38066668/1d9990079c267a689647cf27c5b190789a13ac9b.jpg

We will give more details over time, we hope you like it !!!
